name: wallet_chain_token_balances
description: Get a wallet's native balance and token balances on one EVM chain. Provide chain_id, address, and optional token_addresses. If token_addresses is omitted, the tool returns the chain native asset plus five mainstream tracked tokens for that chain.

chain_id.description: Target chain identifier such as ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, bsc, polygon, avalanche, or numeric chain IDs like 1 and 8453.

address.description: Wallet address on the selected chain.

token_addresses.description: Optional ERC-20 contract addresses to query on the selected chain. If omitted, the tool uses the chain's default tracked token list.
